permRequired: This command needs a higher user level for this step. Add a User level check before it.
noTrigger: Add a When step to start this recipe.
multipleTriggers: A recipe can only start one way. Remove the extra When step.
cycle: This step loops back on itself. Remove one of the connections.
unconnectedNode: This step is not connected to the start. Connect it or remove it.
unknownPort: A connection leaves this step from a port it does not have. Reconnect it.
unstructuredMerge: A path with a Wait cannot join back into another path. Move the Wait after the join or give each path its own steps.
unsupportedNode: This step cannot be saved yet.
unsupportedTrigger: This start cannot be saved yet.
unsupportedCondition: This check cannot be saved yet.
unsupportedAction: This action cannot be saved yet.
unsupportedDisabledControlFlow: A turned off check or group cannot open here. Edit it in Automations.
waitTooLong: This wait is longer than a recipe can pause.
unmappableToken: {token} is not available with this start. Remove it or change the start.
userNotResolved: Pick a Twitch user. Type a name and leave the field so it can be checked.
usesToken: {count} and {uses} only work in commands. Remove them to save this as a recipe.
commandExists: A command with this trigger already exists.
alertExists: That alert is already set up. Edit or turn it off first.
duplicate: A recipe like this already exists.
tooMany: You have reached the recipe limit.
outOfRange: A number is outside the allowed range.
invalidFormat: A value is not in the right format.
simpleWord: Use one simple word for this name: lowercase letters and numbers only, like points or wins.
delayBudget: The waits add up to more than a recipe can pause.
name: Give the recipe a name using letters, numbers and spaces, up to 64 characters.
generic: Check this step's settings and try saving again.
invalidTags: Use up to 10 tags of 25 letters or digits each.
